code-runner-tool-free 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Enables execution of programming tasks in non-interactive environments via PTY pseudo-terminal mode.
- Supports auto-response to common confirmation prompts during code execution.
- Provides file synchronization: copies projects to temp directory for execution, then syncs changes back.
- Includes timeout control and full capture of execution stdout/stderr.
- Command line and Python API usage documented for common automation and development tasks.
- Designed for Unix-like systems (Linux/macOS); Windows support via WSL.
